notes: A maintenance release: nothing you can see behaves differently. · Ice 2 now checks for updates at its own home rather than the website, so a problem with the website can no longer hold one up. This finishes the change 2.14.3 began; updates keep arriving exactly as before.

A maintenance release: nothing you can see behaves differently. · Ice 2 now publishes the file it checks for updates to its own home as well as the website, so a problem with the website cannot hold up an update. The copy you have installed keeps reading the website until a later version moves it across, so nothing changes for you yet.

A maintenance release: nothing you can see behaves differently, and Ice 2's own What's New notes are caught up. · What's New inside the app was four releases behind. The pane still described 2.11.0, so 2.12.0 through 2.14.0 — including item groups being removed, which deleted any groups you had saved — were never announced to anyone who reads the app rather than the changelog. · Nothing changes for the copy you have installed. Every fix here is about letting a development build of Ice 2 run on the same Mac as your installed copy without the two disturbing each other. · Development builds now stay out of the way. Their own version channel, their own helper service, no production update checks, and their own settings-backup folder — so testing a build can no longer prune the installed app's backups or quit it.

Add permission-free menu bar window probe for issue #53 · fix(menubar): hop to main actor inside the rehide timer callback · fix(a11y): add accessibility labels to menu bar end cap pickers · chore: make concurrency annotations match reality

Removed · Item groups are gone. The Groups section in Settings ▸ Layout — saving a set of hidden items under a name and revealing them with Show — has been removed, along with the option to point a trigger at a group. It saw very little use for the amount of the app it occupied, and layout profiles already cover arranging your menu bar. Any groups you saved are deleted from your settings when you update. Triggers still work: a trigger now always shows the hidden section when its app comes to the front, so the Target menu is gone and existing hidden-section triggers are untouched. If you had a trigger pointing at a group, only that trigger is dropped — the rest are kept. · Fixed · Restoring a backup, or using either "Relaunch Ice 2" button, brings Ice 2 back. Ice 2 asked macOS to reopen it *before* quitting, while it was still running — so macOS brought the running copy to the front, reported success, and the quit that followed left nothing running at all. Ice 2 disappeared and did not come back.
